steps.command: git status --short && cat AGENTS.md docs/README.md docs/features/reminders.md larder/reminders.py && rg --files larder tests && rg -n 'sms|email|remind' .

python3 -m pytest -q && python3 - <<'PY'
from unittest.mock import Mock
from larder.reminders import remind

send_sms = Mock()
send_email = Mock()
remind('+351123456789', 'member@example.com', 'tomorrow at noon', send_sms, send_email)
send_email.assert_called_once_with('member@example.com', 'Your pantry order is ready for pickup tomorrow at noon.')
send_sms.assert_not_called()
print('Pickup reminder verified: email sent, SMS not sent.')
PY
